wellbeing.loginNeeded: Soo gal si aad u kaydsato check-in.
wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Quful shay toddobaad, laba toddobaad, bil ama weligeed. Badhanka dhibaatada, caawimaadda dib-u-dhaca, xiriirada wicitaanka ammaanka ah iyo tirtirka xogta weligood lama qufulo.

community.noPhone: Lambarrada telefoonka weligood laguma tuso farriimaha asaaga.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Kulamada laba-iyo-tobanka tallaabo iyo soo kabashada

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Kafaal-qaadahaaga ama xiriirkaaga ammaanka ah hal taabasho u dhawow.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Tani waxay si dhab ah u tirtirtaa xogtaada lamana noqon karo.
safety.wipeConfirm: Waan fahmay tani inay si dhab ah u tirtirto xogtayda.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Taladu waa qarsoodi. Lambarrada telefoonka weligood lama tuso.
reentry.celebrationFirst: Tallaabadii koowaad waa la dhammeeyay — ku soo dhawoow guriga.
reentry.celebrationAll: 33-kii tallaabo waa la dhammeeyay. U dabaaldeg horumarkaaga.
reentry.crisisStep: Kaydso lambaradan hadda. Waxaad sidoo kale taaban kartaa Need help now xagga sare ee shaashad kasta.
reentry.resourceOnly: Tilmaan khayraad oo keliya — Groundwork tani ma bixiso mana la shaqeyso bixiyeyaal.

steps.step4: Deji yoolal lala yeesho maamulaha kiiskaaga
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Hubi waraaqaha sii deynta iyo waqtiyada ugu dambeeya
steps.step10: Xaqiiji taariikhda check-in-ta koowaad iyo shuruudaha
steps.step13: Hel telefoon, iimayl iyo intarneet bilaash ah
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: La xiriir adeegyada dib-u-noqoshada ee deegaanka
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step28: Wax ka baro tababar ama shahaadooyin
steps.step31: La xiriir qoyskaaga, oo haddii ay khusayso maamul masruufka carruurta
steps.step33: Deji yool fog oo u dabaaldeg 90-maalmoodkaaga

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Asal ahaan waa qarsoodi. La wadaag oo keliya markaad go'aansato.

venue.placeholder: Meel ku meel gaar ah — qol cawlan. Sawirro dhab ah ee goobta lama bixin; tani ma aha goobta dhabta ah.

family.help: Qoysku wuxuu arkaa oo keliya waxaad doorato inaad la wadaagto.
family.defaultsOff: Wadaag kasta asal ahaan waa dansan yahay.

phase3.resumeHelp: Ka samee resume qoraal fudud waayo-aragnimadaada.
phase3.headline: Cinwaan
phase3.interviewHelp: Ku celceli jawaabaha. Tababaruhu wuxuu ku siin dhibco iyo talo.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Magaaladaada oo keliya ayaa dadka kale u muuqata. Goobta saxda ah weligeed lama wadaago.
phase3.rideHelp: Codso baabuur. Lambarrada telefoonka weligood lama tuso. Ku kulma meel dadweyne.
phase3.partnersHelp: Kooxo yaryar oo saddex ah oo is caawiya.
phase3.caption: Sharaxaad
phase3.qaHelp: Weydii qarsoodi. Xubnaha hore u socday ayaa ka jawaaba.
phase3.merchHelp: Calaamado kood ah oo keliya. Dibaddu wax macno ah kama sheegayso, taariikho lama daabaco.
phase3.archiveHelp: Shaabadey farriin naftaada. Waxay furantaa maalinta marxaladda.
phase3.matchHelp: Wakiilkaagu wuxuu marka hore la hadlaa wakiillada kale. Shukaansigu hadda waa dansan yahay. Waxaad arki kartaa sababta, codsan kartaa barasho oo dib isku dayi kartaa.
phase3.datingOff: Shukaansigu waa dansan yahay ilaa xeer maalmo ugu yar la dejiyo.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Meesha ugu horreysa la fiiriyo. Ikhtiyaari, heer magaalada oo keliya: arag cidda kulankaaga aadaysa oo ku xirnow farriimaha app-ka. Taleefan ma jiraan, goob sax ah ma jirto.
phase3.groupsHelp: Kooxaha soo kabashada, dib-u-noqoshada, iimaanka iyo bulshada magaalada iyo waqtiga kulanka. Xog tusaale oo keliya — liis dhab ah ma aha.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Waxa la tusa oo keliya marka cidna boodhka carpool-ka aan kulankaaga aadeyn. Waxay dhejisaa codsi la dhexdhexaadiyay oo app-ka ah — heer magaalada oo keliya, telefoon ma jiro.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Kulankan carpool ma leh, sidaa darteed Baabuur u baahanahay ayaa keyd ahaan u muuqata.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Darawallada la oggolaaday oo keliya. Ogeysiisyadu waxay u socdaan mid mid 2-daqiiqo sugitaan ah; waad xaqiijinaysaa intaadan tan xigta ogeysiin.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Heeso tusaale oo keliya. Akoonno streaming ma jiraan. Waa dansan yahay gudaha cutubyada akademiga iyo koorsada.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Muusikadu waa dansan tahay markaad ku jirto cutubka koorsada.
phase3.visLink: Link (la saadaalin karo ma aha, la noqon karo)
phase3.shareWho: Hadda: adiga oo keliya. Samaynta link waxay u oggolaanaysaa qofkii haysta link inuu akhriyo.
phase3.suggestHelp: Talooyin oo keliya — wax lama dhejinayo ilaa aad ku darto.
